تنتقعين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِعِينَ (tantaqiʕīna) /tan.ta.qi.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# تُنْتَقَعِينَ (tuntaqaʕīna) /tun.ta.qa.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
